info.title: dotnet-api-template
info.description: CLI that scaffolds a clean-architecture ASP.NET Core Web API with JWT user management, an invite-by-email flow over Kafka, a transactional outbox, EF Core on PostgreSQL, Redis, a migrator job, background workers and Docker Compose. The project template ships inside the tool.

x-inspectra.cliParsedTitle: dotnet-api-template - scaffold a clean-architecture ASP.NET Core Web API

commands.name: info
commands.description: Show the tool version and check for the SDK, Docker and git

options.name: --project-name
options.description: Name of the project. Becomes the solution name, every project name, assembly name and root namespace.

options.name: --output
options.description: Directory to create the project in. [default: current directory]

options.name: --kafka-topic-prefix
options.description: Prefix for every Kafka topic, the consumer group and the Redis key namespace. [default: derived from the project name]

options.name: --api-port
options.description: Host port Docker Compose publishes the API on. [default: 5080]

options.name: --allow-grpc
options.description: Add a gRPC surface alongside REST, sharing the same query handlers.

options.name: --no-tests
options.description: Omit the unit and integration test projects.

options.name: --no-env
options.description: Do not create .env with generated secrets.

options.name: --no-git
options.description: Do not run git init and the first commit.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print what would happen without writing anything.

commands.name: uninstall-template
commands.description: Unregister the template, leaving the tool installed

commands.name: update
commands.description: Re-register the bundled template with the .NET SDK
